name: Extra Shadow Power
body:
You may use your shadow evocation abilities one additional time per day.

Prerequisite(s): 8th-level shadowdancer

Benefit: You may use your shadow power class feature to create a shadow evocation effect one additional time per day.

Normal: Normally a shadowdancer is able to use the shadow power ability once per day at 8th level and twice per day at 10th level.
